description: Tags of conversion and arithmetic results as returned by ACE: for each of 37 expressions (CByte, CInt, CLng, CSng, CDbl, CCur, CDate, CStr, CBool, CDec, Int, Fix, Round, division, power, Mod, integer division, edge arguments), SELECT expr AS V FROM One read (Field Type/Size and Value), then TypeName and VarType of the same expression. Asks the VARIANT tag, exact bits or payload, and any error.
